skydrama.uk.description: Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend. (Drama / Children) - 1991

skygreats.uk.title: Hook (1991)
skygreats.uk.description: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children. (Adventure / Comedy / Fantasy / Children) - 1991

skygreats.uk.title: Jumanji (1995)
skygreats.uk.description: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free. (Adventure / Comedy / Fantasy / Children) - 1995

skygreats.uk.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982)
skygreats.uk.description: Heartwarming tale in which a ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects. (Adventure / Science fiction / Children) - 1982

skythriller.uk.title: Now You See Me (2013)

skythriller.uk.title: Now You See Me 2 (2016)

skythriller.uk.title: Mr & Mrs Smith (2005)
skythriller.uk.description: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other. - 2005

HubPremier1.sg.title: PL STORIES
HubPremier1.sg.description: PL STORIES From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as succes.

HubPremier1.sg.title: PL REWIND
HubPremier1.sg.description: PL REWIND Yaya Toure is widely regarded as one of the Premier League's most complete midfielders. He was at the peak of his powers in 2013/14, hitting 20 league goals en route to his second league title with Manchester City. The Ivorian shares his memories of the key matches and goals from that campaign.
